svg.title: Innovus routed digital ASIC with functional regions
svg.desc: Native Innovus 23.14 routed layout of rhythm3_axi_event_cf_1v8, cap_cluster_v5. Boxes are bounding extents of selected functional instance sets and may overlap; they are not hard-macro partition boundaries. Snapshot and Final mark their membrane register banks. Clock-gating boxes are padded for label readability. No layout optimization or physical database save was performed.
